A course in a curriculum or stream without a compatible saved timetable is unavailable. A section for a different major does not grant eligibility. Preserve meetings. Never invent or move courses between Semester A and B. Years 1-3 require 5-6 distinct credit-bearing courses, at most 18 credits and at most one distributional GE; compulsory language GE are excluded from that GE cap. If no feasible selection exists, return infeasible and an empty list, never relax the minimum. Year 4 has minimum zero. CM document-listed EF/CS prerequisites are waived as an advisory user assumption; all other supplied restrictions remain. EF without any passed/declared finance study gets an additional penalty 1.5*lambda_background, separate from ordinary mismatch. Passed finance GE or self-reported study removes that extra EF penalty; F/IP/W do not count. This is a utility estimate, not a university prerequisite or measured difficulty. Base mismatch is none .45, introductory .15, advanced .05. Net profit rewards academic/stream progress and subtracts costs and overload; overload weight .25 above 15 credits in Years 1-3, above 12 in Year 4. Return only the requested fields. Unknown future timetables are not offered-course evidence.
